_comment: Fault-injection fixtures. Each case makes one upstream fail and asserts the pipeline degrades to REVIEW rather than ALLOW.

cases.notes: A clean, pinned package would be ALLOW. With the registry unreachable we cannot prove it, so the gate holds.
Without OSV we cannot rule out a MAL- record.
The hard deterministic evidence was already collected; a later failure does not soften it.
A malformed body is an error, not an absence of pickle files.
Tavily is untrusted and soft-only. Losing it must not change a deterministic ALLOW.
No model means no explanation, but the deterministic evidence and verdict stand.
An unloadable policy can never be read as permission.
